admissions.standardisedTests: No SAT or ACT requirement is listed in UM's official undergraduate international FAQ. Check programme pages for any extra requirement.
admissions.englishRequirementNote: These are the general minimums in UM's FAQ. The FAQ also lists programmes that require a higher English score, but it does not publish the higher figure. These are: Shariah and Law; Biomedical Science, Pharmacy and Nursing Science; Biochemistry, Biohealth, Genetics and Microbiology; the Computer Science and IT programmes; Civil, Biomedical, Electrical, Mechanical and Chemical Engineering; Accounting and Business Administration; TESL; Dental Surgery; and English Language and Linguistics. Check the specific figure before applying.
notes: Minimum entry qualification (UM ASD FAQ): 12 years of study and passing STPM, A-Level, IB, High School, Grade 12 or equivalent, or a recognised diploma with CGPA at least 3.00.
No percentage or grade minimum is published, so the matcher cannot check grades. Some selection programmes may also require an interview (ASD FAQ).

The ASD FAQ (last updated 2021) says UM does not offer foundation programmes to international students. The booklet lists foundation programmes priced at 35,000 with no stated currency. This conflict is not resolved here, and no foundation route is recorded.
The ASD FAQ gives the application fee as RM 300. Study@UM states MYR 500 per international application. This build uses the newer Study@UM figure, and it should be confirmed in the portal.

Intake months: the ASD FAQ (2021) says September (deadline 17 June) and February (deadline 11 November). Study@UM says October and March intakes for 2026/27. This build uses Study@UM. The March 2027 international window is 7 September 2026 to 30 January 2027.

Fees are the printed figures in the UM International Booklet (updated 15 Dec 2025). The currency label and fee year are not in the extract, so they are shown as printed, not converted, and not described as verified MYR.
Entry and fees are not a guarantee of admission or funding. Confirm on study.um.edu.my and in the MAYA application portal.
Official ASD FAQ says there are no scholarships for undergraduate international students. The only international-eligible award on UM's official list is external (PTE).
